After thorough analysis of the codebase, I have identified the key locations that need deprecation comments for the Alias plugin. Based on the GitHub issue requesting to "Add a deprecation comment in the Alias Plugin and the Alias Plugin Model", these are the essential locations:

```
cms/cms_plugins.py
line: 28
class: AliasPlugin

cms/models/aliaspluginmodel.py
line: 10
class: AliasPluginModel

cms/templatetags/cms_alias_tags.py
line: 13
function: render_alias_plugin
```

These locations cover:
1. The main AliasPlugin class definition
2. The AliasPluginModel class definition  
3. The template tag function that renders alias plugins

These are the core components of the Alias plugin functionality that would need deprecation warnings to inform users that this feature will be removed in a future version.
